data_fields.name: wound_duration_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 if roll>=335; 6 if roll>=210; 4 if roll>=80; else 1 (roll 0-399)

best_idea: A landed hit starts a wound whose length is rolled once from a weighted table, ticks once a second on the server clock, never stacks, and cannot take the victim below 1 HP.
decision_why: Keep the wound as a rolled, non-stacking status with per-tick damage and a non-lethal floor; fix the donor's thread-pool ticks, self-attributed damage, unsafe player cast and off-target character pass.
acceptance: In a duel a landed wound hit shows a Bleeding icon; the victim loses the fixed tick damage once a second for a rolled 1, 4, 6 or 8 s; a hit during a bleed does not extend it; a server test asserts a bleed tick never takes HP below 1 and never runs outside the server tick.
